data.current_summary: Look up an HSN or SAC code
data.current_description: The official description for a 2 to 8 digit HSN (goods) or SAC (services) code, plus the broader codes it sits under. Served from a local copy of the GST portal's published master (tutorial.gst.gov.in/downloads/HSN_SAC.xlsx), refreshed on demand, so responses are typically under 50 ms. NO GST RATE IS RETURNED: a rate is not a function of the code alone (the same HSN attracts different rates by condition under different notifications) and the government's own master publishes no rate column.
